title: Trade-offs in Image Generation: How Do Different Dimensions Interact?

bias_targets.target: Social, cultural, and demographic biases (including racial/ethnic bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using TRIGScore (a VLM-as-judge metric) on images generated from prompts that explicitly encode demographically sensitive phrases (e.g., substituting ethnicities into templates like 'a lazy [ethnicity] worker'). The VLM assesses whether the generated images reinforce harmful stereotypes or represent the prompt in a fair and equitable manner.
Evaluated in baseline ablation comparisons by measuring the 'Simple Gender Proportion' in generated images to assess representational fairness.
